[[Toshau's Spear]] is a [[unique item]] dropped by [[Toshau Sharpspear]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Garden of Seborhin]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])

:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Spiraling Spear]].
